§6Power Core (High)§f

§aThe elite core. For when your reactors output more power than you know what to do with.§f

The §bPower Core (High)§f builds §bPowercell (High)§f blocks. A 9×9×9 High network pushes §e729,000 RF/t§f per side. That's enough to feed any reactor in this pack directly, no intermediate storage needed. The recipe combines both a Diamond and an Emerald in one core, so it's pricier than Medium.

§6Crafting§f: §b1 Redstone Block§f + §b1 Diamond§f + §b1 Emerald§f + §b4 Redstone or Dimensional Shards§f

§cWARNING:§f Each Powercell (High) upgrade burns §e4 cores§f, and a full 9×9×9 network eats hundreds. Start stockpiling diamonds and emeralds now.
